title: Streaming Player
results: Version 2.0.0 released with a Rust backend and React dashboard
One Docker image for self-hosted deployment
subtitle: Song requests, from chat to OBS
description: Twitch, YouTube live chat and chat bots share one song queue. A Rust backend keeps the OBS player, overlay and moderator dashboard in sync.
longDescription: Streaming Player 2.0 is a self-hosted song request system rebuilt with Rust and React. Viewers request songs from Twitch, YouTube live chat or an HTTP API; moderators manage the same queue from a dashboard. Dedicated OBS browser sources provide playback and a transparent now-playing overlay. It replaces the earlier Flask players.
features: Twitch, YouTube live chat and HTTP chat-bot requests
Queue limits, cooldowns, voting and block lists
OBS player and transparent now-playing overlay
Roles, permission points and personal API tokens
